description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}, putting your entire library into your hand and losing life equal to each card's mana value.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling a card from your hand, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Pestilence twice by paying {B}{B}, dealing 2 damage to each creature and each player.
Your life total is instead set to one due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 3.
